A clean sweep for ! India wrap up the three-match T20I series 3-0 with another commanding victory over Zimbabwe!
Harmanpreet Kaur and Shafali Verma set the tone with the bat before Nandani’s three-wicket haul, backed by Deepti Sharma, Gaud and Reddy, ensured Zimbabwe had no way back!
A dominant all-round show from India to cap off a clinical series whitewash!
